source: Files Platform behaviour; Transfers; SH-07; TF-X02
missing_acknowledgement: Typed browser-authorised selection/reference registration, lifetime, origin, account/organisation binding and cancellation; an opaque string cannot imply arbitrary local file access.

Authenticated bounded/chunked byte transport: declared size/hash/expected revision, resumable chunk acknowledgement and validated committed offsets, durable transfer identity and replay-safe operation key.

Authoritative quota reservation/begin/commit/abort reconciliation, source revision and metadata commit proof; FilesTransfer.Completed alone cannot establish both durable bytes and authoritative FileID/revision metadata commit.

Protected download content or stream descriptor: exact canonical item/revision/hash/length, current permissions, expiry/revocation and progress; browser sink cancellation/denial distinct from provider transfer completion.
Actual authenticated HTTP/stream transport endpoint/schema and session/broker integration, without client-selected actor as authority.
Declared browser capability negotiation and actual staging identity; account/private-cache isolation; no public R2 object key or r2.dev route substitutes for protected download.
proposed_scope_after_acknowledgement: Browser-owned transfer adapter only, consuming existing canonical service and authorised handles. Exact owned path to be agreed with B1 runtime before edits; no shared model or private replacement provider.
outcome: NOT_IMPLEMENTED; root prohibits adapter before owning-team contract acknowledgement

gaps: No concrete IFilesService or real IFilesProvider; only a StubProvider in local tests.
Canonical Sync.GetItemState and Sync.ResolveConflict are in specification/action metadata but absent from IFilesService.
Hosted transfer entry points do not declare operation/idempotency key or expected revision/create precondition; acceptance requires retry-safe consequential mutations.
No typed complete per-item bulk succeeded/failed/skipped/rolled-back result contract in observed FilesTransfer; exact structured partial behavior remains a domain gate.
No ten-type Files.Organisation model/actions, context membership schema, separately authorised Tree layout read, or source-reference shared contract in baseline.
Native Files project currently references legacy HUI Haven.UI; browser CUI parity is not established by its class-library name.
No shared organisation/Link/Prototype/Paths/Replay/Variants model or authenticated action implementation found in baseline.
No registered browser surface/rendering/editor routes for these apps.
Shared Productivity Engine, Node Graph, contextual AI, permission broker and source/history contracts cannot be replaced privately.

Model has a limited SiteProject/Page/Component/CMS/asset/environment/domain representation; explicit NavigationModels, LogicGraphIDs, DataBindings, FormBindings, complete SEO, Analytics/Consent and ExtensionState contracts are not present as typed members.
Existing UpdateProjectAsync receives Func<SiteProject,SiteProject>; no acknowledged serializable typed browser semantic action catalogue for page/component/layout/CMS/source round-trip mutation.
No real ISiteCanonicalSourceResolver, ISiteBuildPipeline, ISiteHostingProvider/registry or ISiteArtifactArchive implementation found.
Existing store is local FileSiteWorkspaceStore; no hosted authoritative revision transport or push subscription.
Latest appropriate cakemods Page Editor donor source/parity inventory has not been provided to B4. Missing donor source is not an exemption.
Team C claims Sites source patches; no overlapping B4 modifications permitted.

decision: Validated isolation for arbitrary active customer code under sites.9to1.uk/<site-slug>, or explicitly approved canonical namespace amendment. Paths on one hostname are not different origins.
blocked_scope: Shipping arbitrary active customer content; independent source/editor/contract work remains possible.

observed: CS1593: Func<CanvasChangeEvent,bool> does not take 2 arguments; _events.Any((_, index) => index + 1 > nextCursor)
impact: Sites test project cannot compile via shared Haven.Application reference; discovery not reached and zero test execution.
action: Reported to root for owning-team correction; no competing shared edit and no reduced build substitute.

gaps: No approved supported browser versions supplied; all exact browser/runtime version gates remain unverified.
No affected declared workload/capacity/recovery thresholds supplied to B4; measured data cannot be compared to invented targets.
No authorised deployed Files/Sites/Terra-form frontend/backend identity or installed native second client supplied.
